items.statement: Management acknowledges past SEBI notices and governance issues, and is implementing structural mechanisms to prevent recurrence.

items.statement: Company announced INR 271 crore fresh equity raise, 1.6x existing capital of INR 170 crore, with over 65% from existing investors and promoters subscribing to maximum permissible warrants.
items.quote: The recent announcement of INR 271 crores of fresh equity raise which is 1.6x our existing capital of INR 170 crores is significant. What is even more significant is that over 65% of the upcoming equity is coming from existing investors, which is a true reflection of our success.

items.statement: Promoters subscribed to maximum permissible amount in equity through warrants, displaying commitment and faith in the business.
items.quote: Promoters have also subscribed to a maximum permissible amount in equity through warrants, which again displays the commitment and faith of co-founders in the business.

items.statement: Liquidity level remains adequate at INR 85 crores, more than 10% of AUM, with target of 12-13% minimum liquidity.
items.quote: Liquidity level remains adequate at INR 85 crores, which is more than 10%, so 12-13%, that's our target, that minimum 10% of AUM we should maintain.

items.statement: Company has about INR 500 crores per annum of co-lending and business correspondent lines available besides cash maintained.
items.quote: Besides the cash we maintain, we have about INR 500 crores per annum of co-lending and business correspondent lines, which are available.

items.statement: Operating cash flow not disclosed for Q1; will be provided at 6-month mark
items.quote: For Quarter 1, normally, the cash flow, we won't be doing, it is only financial presentation. So, 6 months, we will disclose the number.

items.statement: Receivables increased to Rs 700 crore and 42-43 days due to weak sector cash flows and rapid expansion
items.quote: Q1, approximately around Rs. 700 crores.

items.statement: Payables rose to Rs 750 crore with acceptances at Rs 500 crore bearing 9.25-9.5% interest
items.quote: Payable number as of June is Rs. 750 crores.

items.statement: Promoters have not sold stake; only bought back shares after Apollo deal; percentage changes due to warrant conversion
items.quote: Nothing has been sold actually. If you do check, actually said they actually bought more stake rather than sold anything.

items.statement: Q1 FY25 operating cash flow was Rs353m versus Rs691m in Q1 FY24, lower due to Rs300m+ additional payments to paper vendors for inventory built up last season
items.quote: In terms of Cash Flows, our strategy of focusing on the cash flows has yielded results where we ended the quarter with OCF of Rs353m in the current quarter (vs. Rs691m in the same time last year).

items.statement: Net cash balance increased to Rs882m at end of Q1 FY25 from Rs600m at end of Q4 FY24
items.quote: We continued our strong cash flow generation and remained net debt free at the end of the quarter with an increased net cash balance of Rs882m (Vs. Q4FY24: Rs600m).

items.statement: Trade receivables reduced to Rs1,663m in Q1 FY25 from Rs1,732m in Q1 FY24, a Rs69m decrease YoY
items.quote: Trade Receivables reduced to Rs1,663m during Q1FY25 vs. Rs1,732m during Q1FY24. This is a Rs69m decrease in receivables YoY.

items.statement: Receivable days improved to 92 days in Q1 FY25 from 103 days in Q1 FY24, lowest in company history for Q1
items.quote: In terms of receivable days, it stood at 92 days (vs. 103 days in Q1FY24), a reduction of 11 days over the previous year. This is the lowest receivable days in Q1 in in the company's history.

items.statement: Net working capital days reduced to 132 days in Q1 FY25 from 143 days in Q1 FY24, lowest in company history for Q1
items.quote: Net Working Capital reduced to 132 days (vs. 143 days in Q1FY24) which is a reduction of 11 days over the previous year. This is the lowest net working capital days in Q1 in the company's history.

items.statement: Management states average receipt cycle for supervision work is 60-75 days and payments are 100% guaranteed due to selective client selection.
items.quote: So average receipt of the supervision work is 60 to 75 days, which is 100% guaranteed, because we only work with the clients where there is a sufficient fund provision and where there is a good budget backup and good, you can say, payment mechanism.

items.statement: Management says mobilization advances from new orders will improve cash flows in the current financial year.
items.quote: Definitely, because everywhere there is a provision of advances, mobilization advance. So we would like to take that opportunity. Few of them are interest-free. So we would like to take that opportunity to improvise on our cash flows.

items.statement: Board approved rights issue of equity shares face value Rs 2 each for aggregate amount not exceeding Rs 205 crore subject to approvals
items.quote: Additionally, the Board has approved the raising of funds through issuance and allotment of equity shares of the Company of face value Rs. 2 each (Rupee Two Only) for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 205 crore on rights issue basis subject to receipt of statutory and regulatory approvals, as may be applicable.

items.statement: DSOs improved to 79 days from 115 days at quarter end after collections received
items.quote: We are pleased to report that adjusted for the collections received to date, our DSOs now stand at 79 as compared to 115 as reported at the end of the quarter.

items.statement: CFO was around Rs.18 crores in Q1 FY25 due to stressed receivables, normally Rs.25-30 crores
items.quote: So since this last quarter, we had a stressed receivable, we were down to around Rs.18-odd crores in CFO, at our console level.

items.statement: Cash and bank balance approximately Rs.80 crores as of June 2024
items.quote: As of June 2024, the group's gross debt stands at ~Rs.389 crores with cash and bank balance of approximately Rs.80 crores, this results in a net debt of around Rs.308 crores.

items.statement: No fresh equity issuance planned; growth to be funded through internal accruals and project-specific debt
items.quote: Going forward, on a steady state of affairs, if the company doesn't bag any contracts and we have a decent cash flow, we would completely be debt-free in the next four years' time frame.

items.statement: Collected INR6 crores towards home lighting in Q1 FY25; expect to receive most overdue receivables by September-October
items.quote: So if you see, as compared to previous quarter, we have collected almost INR6 crores towards the home lighting. And in retail lighting also, we are following up very aggressively. So by September or October end, we will be able to receive most of the amount, which is above six months.

items.statement: IPO proceeds mostly used for raw material procurement; about Rs 3 crore kept in fixed deposit
items.quote: This working capital is only utilized in our procurement of raw material which was the reason why we raised IPO. It was mentioned as well and that's exactly were the fund has been utilized. Most of the fund is utilized there. I think we have very little, which is in the form of FD. I am not sure about the exact number it should be around 3 crores.

items.statement: Company has no bad debts, major claims, or held-up full container loads
items.quote: Financially, the company has demonstrated sound management practices with no occurrences of bad debts, major claims, or held up full container loads.

items.statement: Promoter infused over Rs.150 crore in last five years and stake reduced due to 12.5% allotment to lenders via NARCL for debt resolution
items.quote: With the aforesaid focused strategy of the business, the promoter is in the process to improve the liquidity of the company and has infused over Rs.150 crore in last five years, successfully resolved the debt issue with the lenders and is ready to grow the company, along with the growing opportunity in the water sector.

items.statement: Company exploring possibility of fundraising to improve liquidity further; no conclusion reached yet
items.quote: We are exploring the possibility of raising, because of the various opportunity available in the water sector, and we can accelerate our growth. We are exploring at the company level that whether we should target further fundraising, but till date, we have not arrived at a conclusion towards this aspect.

items.statement: Promoter stake reduced due to allotment of 12.5% shareholding to lenders through NARCL in debt resolution process
items.quote: Inspite of continuous infusion of funds, the promoter stake further reduced due to allotment of 12.5% shareholdings to the lenders through NARCL in the process of debt resolution.

items.statement: Company has Rs.84 crore fixed deposits, expects Rs.40 crore from Vivad se Vishwas, and promoter warrants for total Rs.150 crore visibility for BG purposes
items.quote: We have roughly around Rs.84 crore of fixed deposit, which is in our hand. We are expecting further amount from Vivad se Vishwas of approximately around Rs.40 crore, and we have some warrant of the promoter, so roughly around Rs. 150 crore availability and visibility is there for the fund for the BG purpose.

items.statement: Current FD around Rs.80-90 crore, visibility of Rs.40-50 crore from Vivad se Vishwas in 2-3 months, plus promoter warrants for Rs.160-170 crore total BG fund availability
items.quote: As | told you we have the visibility, at the moment we have around Rs.80-90 crore of fixed deposit. We have the visibility in next two to three months, another Rs.40-50 crore of Vivad se Vishwas money which is at the final stage, and any day it can come and we have the promoters warrant also. So, roughly around Rs.160-170 crore visibility we have, that fund will be available for the BG purpose

items.statement: Q1 FY25 standalone revenue approximately Rs. 89 crores, up from Rs. 80 crores in Q1 FY24
items.quote: On a standalone basis, the revenue for the 1st Quarter is approximately Rs. 89 crores. This is a good growth from the corresponding figures of Q1 of last year, which was about Rs. 80 crores.

items.statement: Cash balance of Rs. 140 crores as of now, with Rs. 60 crores stuck in RERA accounts and the rest available for free use
items.quote: As of now, Rs. 140 crores of balance is with the Company, out of which close to Rs. 60 crores is stuck in RERA bank accounts, and rest is with the Company for free use for future projects as well as for ongoing projects.

items.statement: Promoter group waived their share of the final dividend for FY24.
items.quote: The promoter group has opted to waive their share of the dividends.

items.statement: GDL acquired over 1% in Snowman this year, now holds 46.4%, plans to complete 5% creeping acquisition to exceed 50%
items.quote: See, we are allowed to acquire 5% under creeping acquisition rules. items.statement: Operating cash flow will increase as revenue shifts to ethanol; combined units have INR 90-100 crores receivables from OMCs
items.quote: See, the cash flow will be increasing now because most of our revenue has gone towards the ethanol business now. And if you combine both our units on an average basis, we have about INR 90 crores to INR 100 crores lying with the OMCs as the receivables

items.quote: Our collections at INR 321 crores were up by 10% year -on-year.

items.quote: We had INR30 crores cash flow operations, reasonably encouraging considering modest or soft quarter that we had and net-net, we repaid INR27 crores of loans.

items.quote: Therefore, free cash flow before new project investment was marginally negative at INR18 crores and as I said, we acquired two projects.

items.quote: if I rework this number from FY '25, '26, '27 perspective we expect another INR300 crores of capital can be unlocked from the projects that are on ground. This is the free cash flow that we think.

items.quote: we are looking at some acquisition options that we've already mandated this to few companies, few consultancies where we are looking at LCL acquisition which we've been working on for last one and a half year which will fuel our inorganic growth. so that is what we are looking for using this cash for that purpose. Also, maybe in times to come, we may have to infuse this back into our working capit

items.statement: Whole-Time Director Aman Baid acquired 2,12,500 equity shares at INR 44,64,400, increasing promoter holding from 34.8% to 34.98%.
items.quote: Additionally, as a Whole-Time Director within the Promoter Group, I have acquired 2,12,500 equity shares at INR44,64,400. This acquisition is intended to enhance the Promoter's stake in the company. Following this, the Promoter shareholding has increased from 34.8% to 34.98%.

items.statement: Debt reduced from INR115 crores in March 2023 to INR85 crores in March 2024; target to be debt-free by March 2027-28
items.quote: Like last year, in March 23, my debt was around INR115 crores. And now in March 24, that is around INR85 crores.And my target is that by March 27 , 28, we should be debt -free.

items.statement: Milan Dalal acquired 500,212 shares in the open offer, crossing the 25% threshold to enable creeping acquisitions up to 5% annually.
items.quote: While I did mention in my opening remarks, but it's a public knowledge and I have no hesitation in confirming with you that I got 500,212 shares to be precise.

items.statement: Received Rs. 14 crore under Maharashtra WIPS scheme in FY24
items.quote: Yes, we are availing WIPS scheme in Maharashtra like other wineries are and last year we received around Rs. 14 crore in FY24.

items.statement: Focus on working capital optimization remained a priority throughout the quarter
items.quote: Additionally, our focus on working capital optimization remained a priority throughout the quarter.

items.statement: Promoter stake will marginally reduce from 72.8% to around 71.5-72% after QIP
items.quote: So, before QIP, promoter stake was approximately 72.8%. With QIP, it will, I have not exact numbers, but it will marginally reduce to around 71.5% or 72%.

items.statement: Reduced third-party unskilled manpower by 20% and overtime by 98% from May to August while maintaining sales.
items.quote: So actually, as compared to April versus August, we have done a higher sale. I can't tell the August numbers, but we've done a higher sale, but at the same time July when I say August is still running, but we have reduced the third party, the unskilled manpower by 20% on the over time, we have reduced by 98% percent.

items.statement: 4 MW captive solar plant and 1.3 MW rooftop solar operational; IEX bidding started; expecting significant power cost reduction.
items.period: from 20th July / first week of August
items.quote: We have already this off site, 4 MW of captive solar plant which we had invested which we had partnered with an outside party which were started. So, they have started, they have already gone live from 20th of July of this year and we have already started receiving solar power supply from them close to 4 MW.

items.statement: RACL holds 6% equity stake in the SPV owning the 15 MW captive solar plant (4 MW allocated to RACL).
items.quote: Technically, RACL has a 6% stake in this SPV. This particular facility is actually 15 MW capacity, out of 15 MW capacity, 4 MW is for us, so technically is a captive power plant and as per guidelines, we are actually equity partnered in this company, so technically 6%, around 6% of the equity of this particular SPV is owned by RACL

items.statement: Management states inventory days increased due to higher exports and Red Sea crisis extending transit time to 100 days, but cash flow not disturbed as transit inventory cost is built into costing.
items.quote: Eventually, our inventory days will increase, so inventory is not something which is only our raw material Inventory or finished goods inventory. The real is coming on the transistor inventory. What that cost of the transistor inventory is built up into the costing. It's not disturbing our cash flow.

items.statement: Management confirms net debt will reduce this year as repayments exceed new borrowings, with long-term debt reduction targeted for FY25.
items.quote: It it will reduce net debt will reduce this year.

items.statement: Management acknowledges investor suggestion to strengthen balance sheet via preference shares or QIP but defers strategic decision to appropriate time.
items.quote: We got to know, let this investor call be more focused towards our performance. These are all strategic surprise. Thanks for your message. But definitely these are our strategic decisions and yes, at the right time, the right decision will be on a take.

items.statement: Operating cash flow generation is strong and sufficient to fund capex without equity dilution
items.quote: We want to keep a healthyratio between debt and equity. If required, we'll raise equity also. But until we can manage debt within sustainable levels, we'll continue with debt
